center_embeddings: center the embedding weights by shifting each embedding to have a mean of zero
fuse_norm_linears: fuse the scaling operation of a norm layer into subsequent linear layers
test_center_embeddings: test center_embeddings shifts embedding weights to zero mean while preserving dtype
test_fuse_norm_linears: test fuse_norm_linears multiplies linear weights by norm weights and resets norm to ones
review_fuse_norm_linears: review fuse_norm_linears for transform invariance between norm and linear layers
